items.title: 6.5 Applications and Implications of Blockchain (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Blockchain ek khaas technology hai jo maloomat ko mehfooz rakhne mein madad karti hai. Yeh aisi digital notebook ki tarah hai jise sab dekh sakte hain lekin koi badal nahi sakta. Aaiye dekhein ke asal duniya mein yeh kaise istemal hoti hai: products ka origin (kahan se aaya) dhoondna, financial services, aur data security.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein blockchain ke kaun se teen istemal parhaye gaye hain?
blocks.explanation: Products ke origin ki tracking (6.5.1), financial services (6.5.2), aur data security (6.5.3).

items: Blockchain: digital notebook jise sab dekhein, koi badal na sake.
Istemal: product tracking, financial services, data security.
